messages.subject: Plotting Data onto World Map
parts:
So I can figure out from the ggplot2 website how to make the world map
show up:

world <- data.frame(map("world", plot=FALSE)[c("x","y")])
worldmap <- qplot(x,y,data=world, geom="path")
worldmap + coord_map()

But what I can't figure out is how to add data points onto that. I
have earthquake data, where each row is an earthquake, and two of the
columns are the Latitude and Longitude, named Lat and Lon. I tried
obvious things like:

worldmap + coord_map() + geom_point(aes(Lat,Lon))

I've also tried many other things, but can't figure out how to
accomplish this seemingly simple thing.

Any advice? Thanks!
